    Fibre algebras of deformation families (toward Proposition 12.8) #

    A scalar fibre of a family m + Σ_i t_i μ_i (characteristic-two-construction.tex) is the underlying space of Λ with an associative unital bilinear product. Fib A is that algebra (AssocMul). When the product agrees with that of Λ up to terms raising the length degree, the length filtration of Λ makes Fib A a positive filtered deformation of Λ (Fib.posFiltration, Definition 6.2).

    Type v

    An associative unital k-bilinear product on Λ.

    • mm : Λ →ₗ[k] Λ →ₗ[k] Λ
    • assoc (a b c : Λ) : (self.mm ((self.mm a) b)) c = (self.mm a) ((self.mm b) c)
    • one_left (a : Λ) : (self.mm 1) a = a
    • one_right (a : Λ) : (self.mm a) 1 = a
